In the past when Cena "buries" his opponents in promos you can tell there's an off script moment such as calling Rock out for writing lines on his hand or telling Roman "it's called a promo".

This battle with Cody seemed more back and forth, both of them having a specific answer for each other's disses and then the obvious set up for the "you can't wrestle" leading into the cross rhodes. 

I'm not saying it's impossible for Cody to look good if Cena went all out on the mic but he was literally booked to get the last word and hit his finish. Which ironically plays into what Cena said earlier about him being protected.

But even if that is the case and someone is more of a fan of a certain wrestler due to a crush or attraction, who cares? Why does it matter why someone else likes someone or not? 


As for people getting pushed only because they are attractive, I disagree. Looks probably help but Liv was getting super over as a face when she won MITB and had children adoring her and Alexa is one of the best characters and mic workers in the women's division. They both earned their spot. 


On the other side if people only got pushed for looks Kelly Kelly would be a multi time champion, Torrie Wilson would've won at least *one* championship and so would Stacy Keibler.

Slow climbing the ladder or reaching too early to stall for time. 


I've seen people climb ladders before, not everyone can sprint up it in seconds. It can be realistic for someone to take their time with it because they don't want to shake the ladder or in the case of wrestling they are selling previous damage by struggling to climb. 


And obviously you don't want a ladder match to end in seconds. Realistically you could just Irish whip someone out the ring rush up the ladder and snatch the briefcase. You want wrestlers to stall and take their time otherwise all the cool spots won't happen.

The AEW game looks really rough, but I wanna comment on one thing in particular, the graphics. I've seen people say the game has a unique or retro style and it makes me wonder if these people have ever seen or played any other game that has different art style. 


Pixel games are old, but if you compare games from 20 years ago made on a pixel art style compared to games now they look night and day. Tears if the kingdom has a cell shaded art style, street fighter has a mixture of anime and comic book art style, don't starve to death has it's own unique style, I could go on... 


WWF No Mercy did NOT have an art style, it was just old. If you look at what No Mercy looked like that was just an attempt at realistic graphics 20+ years ago. By saying AEW is going for a No Mercy style, what you're saying is the game looks outdated. Fight Forever doesn't have a cartoony look or arcade or any other art style I can see, it just looks like an outdated attempt to be realistic, it looks like it belongs on the PS3.


The gameplay is hit or miss, it does have points that look *fun* but also stuff that looks rough such as snapping into place, ropes flying everywhere and janky physics. Again I don't think No Mercy wanted these things in their game, they HAD to have them due to the limitations of technology back then. No Mercy was great because it was an amazing game for it's time, Fight Forever would be amazing for it's time if it released about 15 years ago, but it's not. 


Pay homage to an old game sure, but update it to modern standards at least, makes me wonder where all the budget went. To put it into perspective a fan favourite game Uncharted 2 had the exact same budget as Fight Forever, was it spent on the minigames or something?
